servinfo.title: Front Side-Impact G Sensor Removal and Installation (8-Channel Air Bag System)

attention1.ptxt: Failure to take proper precautions when handling the air bag system sensors can result in personal injury due to non-deployed air bag system in the event of an accident or accidental air bag deployment.

item.ptxt: Never impact or shake the sensors.
Otherwise, proper operation of the sensors cannot be assured.
Always tighten the mounting bolts to specified torque when installing the sensors. Otherwise, proper operation of the sensors cannot be assured.

s1.ptxt: Disconnect front side-impact G sensor connector (2) as follows.

s2.ptxt: Release locking slider (1) by sliding it in arrow direction “1”.
Disconnect front side-impact G sensor connector by pulling it in arrow direction “2”.

s1.ptxt: Remove front side-impact G sensor bolt (3) and remove front side-impact G sensor (4) from center pillar inner lower panel (5).

ptxt.intxrefpoff: Front Side-Impact G Sensor Inspection (8-Channel Air Bag System)

s1.ptxt: Check that none of the following faulty conditions exists.

item.ptxt: Bend, deformation or rust on side sill scuff

s1.ptxt: Align mounting pin (1) with mounting hole (2) of vehicle to install front side-impact G sensor (3).
Tighten front side-impact G sensor bolt to specified torque.
Connect front side-impact G sensor connector securely.
